ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 23 of 27 April 2015 on Money Laundering and Terrorism Financing Prevention, as amended by Law 70 of 2019 and Law 254 of 2021; the Beneficiary Owner / Transparency Registry (Registro de Transparencia y Beneficiario Final) is implemented through the Registro Público de Panamá. Additional AML/CFT guidance is issued by the Financial Intelligence Unit of Panama (Unidad de Análisis Financiero, UAF).

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories against the OFAC SDN list, UN Consolidated Sanctions List, EU Sanctions List, and Panama's internal Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) registry. Enhanced due diligence, independent source-of-wealth verification, and senior management approval are mandatory for any identified PEP, family member, or close associate. A properly documented AML/CFT risk assessment and UBO identification form must be completed and retained by the registered agent before incorporation.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá (official corporate registry portal: https://www.registropublico.gob.pa; online name search and reservation through the SAG / Sistema de Trámites en Línea modules)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate filings and the proposed name reservation application must be drafted in Spanish. Foreign names are transliterated into the Latin script according to Panamanian registry practice; a name may be retained in its original Latin script if it is phonetically representable and does not conflict with an existing registered name. Names must comply with local public-order rules and may not imply a regulated, governmental, or charitable purpose without appropriate authorization.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the proposed name is rejected, the applicant or its registered agent must file a formal administrative appeal (recurso de reconsideración y, en su caso, apelación) with the Registro Público de Panamá within ten business days of the rejection notice. The appeal must include a supporting memorandum, revised name alternatives, and any evidence of prior registration or consent from the relevant regulator for sensitive words. A decision is rendered by the Directorate General of the Registro Público; further judicial recourse lies in the Administrative Chamber of the Supreme Court (Sala Tercera de la Corte Suprema de Justicia).

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office arrangements are generally permissible for a non-licensed overseas public relations and communications holding vehicle, provided that a licensed registered agent maintains a physical Panamanian office, is authorized to accept service of process, and maintains the registered address records required under Law 23 of 2015. A virtual office cannot substitute for the physical office of the registered agent, and regulated financial activities would require additional commercial substance.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low; approximately 5% likelihood of an unannounced on-site inspection during the first year for a standard low-risk media relations firm, subject to increase if sanctions list hits, PEP flags, adverse media, or unusual transaction patterns arise.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Panama Law No. 32 of 1927 on Corporations, as amended (General Corporations Law), Sections 1-10 and 52-86 (incorporation, registered office, directors and officers)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sección Mercantil (Public Registry of Panama, Mercantile Section)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución / Aviso de Constitución (Public Deed of Incorporation / Incorporation Notice registered in the Mercantile Section)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for a Sociedad Anónima; capital may be expressed in any currency and paid in installments, with no escrow account requirement.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION NO. 1 OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS. The undersigned directors, constituting a quorum, resolve: (1) to accept the subscription of the corporate capital as set forth in the incorporation documentation; (2) to adopt the registered office at the address stated in the Articles of Incorporation; (3) to appoint the named individuals as President, Treasurer, Secretary, and their alternates; (4) to authorize the President and Secretary to open bank accounts, sign contracts, and file all regulatory registrations; and (5) to approve the commencement of international media relations and crisis public relations services. All actions shall comply with Panama Law No. 32 of 1927, as amended. The resolution is effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft and Notarize the Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public of Panama City (Notaría Pública)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a Panamanian attorney to draft the Escritura Pública in Spanish, including corporate name, registered office, capital structure, director appointments, and corporate purposes. Execute the deed before a licensed Panamanian notary, who will issue the notarized first extract.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate name and certificate of no prior registration (Vista o Certificado del Registro Público)
Draft Articles of Incorporation (Escritura Pública)
Identity and domicile documents of at least three directors (passport or national ID)
Identity documents of the incorporator (if different from directors)
Power of attorney if the incorporator is not personally present
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or name reservation is rejected due to similarity or deficiencies, correct the proposed name and resubmit the application to the Registro Público through the same notary within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File the Notarized Deed with the Mercantile Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sección Mercantil
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarized public deed and relevant annexes to the Mercantile Section of the Registro Público, either physically or through the electronic submission system, pay the applicable registration fee, and request the inscription of the corporation.
required_dossiers: Notarized Escritura Pública de Constitución (original)
Cover letter or mercantile filing form
Payment receipt for registration tariff
Certified copy of the identity documents of directors and officers
Tax identification number form (Aviso de Inscripción / Registro Único de Contribuyente request, if filed concurrently)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a defect or preventive annotation, provide corrected pages or explanatory legal brief within 10 business days; strict compliance with notarial formalities cures most queries.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register for Taxpayer Identification and Municipal Operation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas — Dirección General de Ingresos; and Municipality of Panama
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the Registro Único de Contribuyente (RUC) application with the National Revenue Directorate and obtain the company tax ID. Then file an Aviso de Operación with the municipality of the registered address to obtain the local operation permit for service activities.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the registered Escritura Pública (Testimonio)
Certificate of legal existence from Registro Público (Paz y Salvo / certificado)
RUC application form signed by the legal representative
Registered office address verification (rental contract or title deed)
Identity and appointment documents for the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the revenue authority questions the RUC application, file amended information and supporting evidence through the DGI online portal; municipal aviso queries may be cured by updating the address and paying the municipal fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open Corporate Bank Account and Appoint Resident Agent Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial banking institution and the retained Panama law firm acting as registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the certified corporate public deed, the RUC certificate, the registered agent consent, and board resolution authorizing account opening to the chosen bank. The resident agent shall maintain the corporate register and statutory records as required by law.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the registered Escritura Pública
RUC certificate
Board resolution designating account signatories
Passport of beneficial owner and signatories
Reference letters and proof of professional reputation (for AML compliance)
Registered agent services agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests enhanced due diligence, supply a notarized source-of-funds declaration and audited or unaudited financial statements; the agent can coordinate the response with the bank's compliance unit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issue Corporate Governance Records and Tax Registration Finalization
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered agent office and Dirección General de Ingresos
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute and endorse the first board resolution, open the statutory books (minutes, shareholders' register, share ledger, and accounting records), and obtain the definitive RUC certificate with economic activity ISIC 7310 / NAICS 541820. File any required annual municipal declaration if operation has commenced.
required_dossiers: Certified original of the board resolution
Statutory ledger and share register signed by corporate officers
RUC provisional certificate for replacement with final certificate
Municipal Aviso de Operación stamped copy
Copy of the registered agent appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the revenue authority requests revision of economic activity codes, submit a written application to reclassify the activity and attach the registered corporate purpose; the registry will issue the corrected RUC within 5 business days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — the overseas PR communication firm performs professional services only and is not subject to industrial licensing; municipal Aviso de Operación is the sole operational permit.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Aviso de Operación (Municipal Operation Notice) issued by the Municipality of Panama for professional service activities

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — Category III no low-impact service office activity requires no EIA report; only a negative environmental declaration may be required if the office generates ordinary solid waste and sewage connected to municipal networks.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to the corporate office; Panama's general regulations require wastewater discharge into the municipal sewer system only with municipal authorization, ordinary solid waste delivered to licensed municipal collection, and no VOC or industrial emissions are generated by the PR service operations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The municipal Aviso de Operación is conditioned on compliance with the local fire safety certification (Certificado de Seguridad contra Incendios) issued by the Fire Department (Benemérito Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá), structural load clearance for the rented office space, and workplace occupational health registration with the Ministry of Labor (MITRADEL) for employees.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas, Panama; taxpayer portal: https://www.dgi.gob.pa (Panamanian government electronic tax services portal).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Panama S.A. must be incorporated through a local registered agent, obtain a business operation notice (Aviso de Operación), and register with the Public Registry. The entity must then apply to the DGI for a RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyentes) by filing the public deed, registered agent acceptance, registered office certificate, identity documents of officers/shareholders, and the completed RUC application. The same RUC is used for corporate income tax and ITBMS registration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election exists under Panamanian law. A Sociedad Anónima is automatically taxed as a separate entity. Optional regimes for qualifying businesses include the Multinational Headquarters (SEM) license under Law 41/2007, which grants special tax incentives, and DGI administrative classifications such as 'Gran Contribuyente'. No fiscal-transparent election is available for ordinary S.A. entities.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS (Impuesto sobre Transferencias de Bienes Muebles y Servicios)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No statutory economic turnover threshold; registration is mandatory from the first taxable transaction. PAB 0.00
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Panama enforces phased mandatory electronic invoicing (Factura Electrónica). Designated taxpayers must use DGI-authorized billing software or service providers, transmit XML invoices through DGI-approved APIs or platforms, and obtain a DGI-issued authorization code/digital stamp before the invoice has fiscal effect. Exports must be invoiced with ITBMS 0% and cite the supporting export declaration. Smaller non-designated taxpayers continue under transitional manual invoicing until the DGI implementation calendar reaches their segment.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods qualify for 0% ITBMS when the sale is made to a foreign customer, title and risk transfer abroad, and the goods physically leave Panama with a valid customs export declaration. Offshore services qualify if the beneficiary is established outside Panama and the services are effectively used or consumed in a foreign jurisdiction; local invoicing to a Panamanian entity is insufficient. Taxpayers must retain contracts, invoices, proof of export shipment, and evidence of foreign inward remittance to substantiate zero-rating.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración Única Aduanera - DUA) stamped by Panamanian Customs
Bill of Lading / Airway Bill or equivalent transport document
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT/foreign payment credit advice from a Panamanian bank
Commercial invoice and contract demonstrating 0% ITBMS treatment
Loading or customs exit record confirming physical departure of goods
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGI and Panamanian Customs (Aduana Nacional) cross-match export declarations, ITBMS returns, and foreign banking remittances. If zero-rating is claimed fraudulently or funds are not repatriated within the confirmed period, the 0% rate is revoked; ITBMS is reassessed at 7% on the gross invoice value, plus default interest and late-payment surcharges. Administrative fines can range up to 100% of the omitted tax, and criminal tax fraud penalties may apply, including imprisonment of up to 5 years and suspension or cancellation of export privileges.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP) is the statutory banking, foreign-exchange conduct, and AML/CFT supervisor; Banco Nacional de Panamá (BNP) acts as fiscal agent and de facto clearing-house manager in the absence of a conventional central bank; the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF) compiles external-account and balance-of-payments statistics under the dollarized regime.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama is a fully dollarized economy: the U.S. Dollar (USD) is legal tender, the Panamanian Balboa (PAB) exists only as divisional coins at a fixed 1:1 parity, and there is no central-bank-issued fiduciary money. Both the current account and capital account are freely convertible; no exchange controls, prior authorization, mandatory conversion, repatriation timelines, or profit remittance restrictions apply to Sociedad Anónima structures. Statutory dividend withholding (generally 5% to 10% depending on the ISR regime and source classification) is triggered only on distributions attributable to Panamanian-source taxable income; foreign-source PR retainer revenue is outside the territorial tax base and may be remitted free of Panamanian withholding. Capital contributions may be repatriated at any time without central-bank consent because no exchange-control authority exists; the only reporting obligation is the SBP transaction-coding and suspicious-activity-reporting regime under Decree Law 2 of 2008 and Law 23 of 2015.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Not applicable: Panama imposes no export-proceeds surrender obligation, no repatriation deadline, and no mandatory conversion ratio for receipts derived from overseas public-relations and communication services. Retainer and campaign fees may be retained offshore indefinitely or banked domestically in USD without conversion. The only administrative requirements are accurate SBP balance-of-payments purpose-coding on each inbound transfer and standard AML/CFT record-keeping by the receiving bank.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Multi-Currency Account with cash management sweep
Capital Escrow Account / Operational Account (fiscal agent facilities)
Operational Treasury-Consolidation Account with trade desk
International Business Account for non-resident flow structures
Operational Account with FX forward desk
Retail-oriented operational account; limited foreign-corporate onboarding

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium. Panama does not issue an EMI-equivalent licence and does not passport foreign e-money licences; the SBP Fintech Innovation Hub (Acuerdo 007-2018) offers a regulatory sandbox but does not confer depository status on offshore digital banks. Offshore EMIs (for example Mercury, Payoneer, MultiPass, or UK-licensed EMI branches) are acceptable only as auxiliary collection rails for retainer ACH and wire receipts, not as the primary treasury custody account. Legal constraints: a foreign EMI taking deposits from a Panamanian S.A. without an SBP licence cannot legally characterize the balance as a guaranteed deposit, and the structure may hinder the economic-substance audit trail; accordingly, use a local tier-1 account as the clearing node and sweep EMI balances into it within 24 hours.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Universal requirement: at least one director or authorised signatory holding a public deed or apostilled power of attorney must attend a physical onboarding interview at the Panamanian bank. Non-resident directors may satisfy this obligation by executing a special power of attorney before a Panamanian Notary Public in favour of a resident legal representative. Full remote opening is generally not permitted for new-formation S.A. entities even in the Low_Risk_Standard category; a hybrid process with video KYC, digital signature, and apostilled corporate documents is accepted by some banks only where the incorporator is a licensed Panamanian law firm with an existing correspondent relationship; otherwise an in-person appearance is mandatory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sociedad Anónima presented with an unidentified beneficial-ownership chain or historical bearer-share indicia, creating an underwriting red flag under Law 23 of 2015.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised share ledger and certified current beneficial-ownership register filed with the Registro Público; nominee-declaration letter from the registered agent confirming no bearer shares are outstanding; Panamanian law-firm legal opinion on the UBO chain; sworn source-of-wealth statement of each ultimate owner; board resolution ratifying the account-opening and operation mandate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Territorial (foreign-source) income claim conflicts with high-velocity USD inflows into a Panama bank account, suggesting undisclosed Panamanian-source activity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited financial statements evidencing territorial-source classification; international retainer contracts with governing-law and performance-location clauses; campaign deliverables and media-calendar evidence showing services rendered outside Panama; the annual economic-substance sworn declaration filed through the DGI virtual system; an independent Panamanian tax-counsel memorandum mapping each revenue stream to the territorial tax base.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid six-figure capital injection into a newly formed S.A. followed by parallel outbound disbursements to overseas PR subcontractors, triggering layering indicators.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Twenty-four-month prior-bank-statement source-of-funds file demonstrating legitimate accumulation; corporate ledger containing the subscription and paid-in-capital resolution; balance-of-payments purpose-code mapping on each inbound MT103 (direct investment equity versus export-of-services); complete sub-contractor KYC kits including UBO declarations; a board-approved cash-flow forecast letter explaining the working-capital cycle and the PR campaign delivery milestones.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Outbound retainer ACH and wire batches to grey-listed or sanctions-adjacent media vendors routed via a mid-tier correspondent bank, creating OFAC name-match alerts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Negative OFAC/EU/UN sanctions-screening outputs with system-generated timestamps; vendor UBO and management certification letters; invoice bundles with media placement and campaign-performance evidence; sworn auto-declaration forms from each beneficiary; and a documented no-transaction rejection log evidencing prompt refusal of any prohibited counterparty.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route all inbound injections as USD SWIFT MT103 transfers with explicit purpose narratives and ISO 20022 External Purpose Codes where the sending bank supports them: (a) equity subscriptions must carry a 'capital contribution / direct investment' narrative and be credited to the Capital Escrow Account; (b) overseas PR retainer fees must carry a 'professional and management consulting services' or 'communication services' narrative per the SBP transaction-coding catalogue. Provide the share-subscription board resolution, source-of-wealth statement, and the client-signed retainer schedule to the receiving bank before settlement; funds are credited on a T+0 basis after the Oficialía de Cumplimiento release. Use only registered correspondent channels; cash-equivalent bearer instruments are prohibited, and family-office trust wiring must be accompanied by trust deed excerpts and a source-of-funds declaration.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Preferred clearing rails: (1) SWIFT MT103 over the receiving bank's CHIPS/Fedwire correspondent network for cross-border disbursements generally in excess of USD 10,000 to PR subcontractors and media vendors; (2) ACH Panamá (Cámara de Compensación Automatizada) for domestic business-expense, payroll, and low-value retainer movements; (3) Commercial Letters of Credit governed by UCP 600 with sight drafts and documents-against-payment terms for production-heavy campaign procurement above USD 50,000, advised through Banistmo's Global Trade Desk, Towerbank, or Citibank Panama; (4) pre-vetted vendor master files and payment-reason narratives on every instruction to expedite OFAC screening and SBP transaction coding. Dual-approval and positive-pay controls are recommended to prevent invoice-redirection fraud.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable Currency Forward (USD/EUR, USD/GBP, USD/JPY) executed with an SBP-licensed bank treasury desk to cover non-USD retainer receivables and campaign payables; zero-cost collar structures are permitted where the contract base currency is non-USD and aggregate exposure exceeds USD 1,000,000.

Cross-Currency Swap (CCIRS) for multi-year global media contracts where both receivables and payables are denominated in the same non-USD currency and the notional exposure exceeds the bank's internal product threshold.

European-Style FX Options (physical or cash-settled) written or advised by a licensed Panamanian bank treasury; speculative standalone option strategies are not permissible for a non-financial ISIC 7310 corporate treasury without an SBP derivatives-dealing licence.

Non-Deliverable Forward (NDF): technically available but economically redundant because PAB is fixed at 1:1 to USD; an NDF would be used only to hedge legacy Balboa-denominated notional exposures, which do not arise in a standard offshore PR agency structure.

Overnight and rolling USD liquidity sweep into SBP-compliant money-market deposit facilities and bank-deposit sweeps as the permitted cash-collateral base; commodity-linked and gold-pegged derivative structures are outside the permitted hedging perimeter for this corporate treasury profile.

stage_5.statutory_deliverable: Annual franchise tax (Anuidad) — corporate maintenance annuity for Sociedad Anónima
stage_5.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance
stage_5.statutory_deadline_window: By March 31, June 30, September 30, or December 31 according to the quarter of incorporation
stage_5.delinquency_sanctions: 5% per month (or fraction) surcharge plus interest on late amounts; collection notices ('avisos de cobro'), restricted certificates of good standing, and administrative strike-off risk from the Public Registry after prolonged default.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% flat rate on net taxable income (Article 699 of the Código Fiscal; Law 8 de 2010; progressive 15%/25% bands for income up to USD 50,000 were eliminated, unifying the rate for all corporate taxpayers).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial source principle: income from public-relations and communication services rendered, negotiated, and delivered entirely outside Panama is excluded from the Panamanian tax base, producing a 0% effective rate for a genuine overseas PR model. Qualifying Multinational Headquarters (SEM, Law 41 de 2007) can obtain a 0% ISR rate on eligible management services; non-resident dividends are taxed at 5% (reduced from 10%); NOLs are usable for 5 years.
